data.name: Broderick
data.long_meaning: Derived from 'Bregdan', a Germanic name composed of 'breg' meaning 'ruler' and 'dun' meaning 'fort' or 'stronghold'. In Christian tradition, Broderick represents bravery, strength, and leadership.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes divine protection and guidance in times of adversity.

in_hebrew.name: ברודריק
in_hebrew.meaning: משמעות של שם האדם שבא מהאנגלית
in_hebrew.long_meaning: שם האדם ברודריק נובע מהמילה האנגלית, ששמעותה 'בן רודריק' (son of Roderick), שהיא יישוב של צורה 'בעל' (of) + 'רודר' (rider, rider of horses), שממנו נגזר שם האדם, ושם האדם של הרודריק, שהיה מצביא ומלך בסקוטלנד, ובאזכור השם, נכלל גם סממני של חזק, גבריות, וסממני הרוח, והיה שם נפוץ בדרך כלל, בקרב הכנסייה, כאנטי-כנסייתי, אולם, נכלל גם שם, בשושלת הבית המלכותי הסקוטי, וכאשר השם, נכלל, בקרב הכנסייה, נכלל גם סממני הקדוש, ואולי בשל כך, נכלל, גם, בשם, אחד הקדושים הקדושים של הכנסייה, של אירלנד, וזה, קדוש, חי בשנים, 450-519, ונפטר, בשנת, 519

in_greek.name: Μπρόδερικ
in_greek.meaning: σημασία ονόματος που προέρχεται από την αγγλική
in_greek.long_meaning: το όνομα Μπρόδερικ προέρχεται από την αγγλική λέξη, η οποία σημαίνει 'γιος του Ρόδερικ', και η οποία είναι μια μορφή της λέξης 'Ρόδερικ', η οποία είναι μια συνθετική λέξη που συνίσταται από το 'Ρόδερ' (οδηγός, ιππικό) και το 'ΙΚ' (υπερασπιστής, ένοπλος). Ο Ρόδερικ ήταν ένας στρατηγός και βασιλιάς της Σκωτίας, και η αναφορά του ονόματος περιλαμβάνει επίσης τα χαρακτηριστικά της δύναμης, του ανδρισμού και της θρησκευτικότητας. Τον 19ο αιώνα, το όνομα Μπρόδερικ χρησιμοποιήθηκε ως εναλλακτική ονομασία για τους αθεϊστές, αλλά επίσης ήταν μια κοινή ονομασία στη βασιλική οικογένεια της Σκωτίας. Όταν το όνομα ενσωματώθηκε στην Εκκλησία, περιλάμβανε επίσης τα χαρακτηριστικά του αγίου, και μπορεί να συνδέεται με έναν αγιογράφημα της Ιρλανδίας, ο οποίος έζησε μεταξύ 450 και 519 και πέθανε το 519

in_latin.name: Brodericus
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Brodericus origine a lingua Anglicana, significans filium Roderici, unde Rodericus, forma composita ex Roder et IC, Roder significans ductorem, equitum, IC significans protector, miles. Rodericus miles et rex Scotiae fuit. Nomen Brodericus, cum in Ecclesia includeretur, includeret etiam characteres fortitudinis, virilitatis, et spiritualitatis. Nomen Brodericus, saeculo XIX, in Ecclesia includeretur, sed etiam in familia regia Scotiae. Cum in Ecclesia includeretur, includeret etiam characteres sancti, et poterit esse relata ad Sanctum Irlandiae, qui vixerat ab anno 450 usque ad annum 519 et mortuus est anno 519

in_english.name: Broderick
in_english.meaning: English name meaning son of Roderick, related to power and nobility
in_english.long_meaning: The name Broderick is derived from the English word, meaning 'son of Roderick', which is a form of the name Roderick, composed of Roder and IC, Roder meaning leader, rider, and IC meaning protector, warrior. Roderick was a military leader and king of Scotland. When the name was included in the Church, it also included characteristics of strength, masculinity, and spirituality. In the 19th century, the name Broderick was included in the Church, but also in the royal family of Scotland. When included in the Church, it included characteristics of the saint, and may be related to a saint of Ireland, who lived between 450 and 519 and died in 519

saint_reference.note: Saint Broderick of Ireland was a 6th-century saint who lived between 450 and 519 AD

data.cultural_impact: The name Broderick has its roots in the Old English language and was popular among the Anglo-Saxon and Irish populations during the Middle Ages. Its connections to the Anglo-Saxon and Irish cultures have influenced its usage in literature, music, and art throughout history. For example, the iconic Irish American actor, Broderick Crawford, is a notable figure who has carried on the legacy of this name.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Broderick carries a deep spiritual significance as it translates to 'ruler of the stronghold' in Old English. For Christians, this name represents strength, courage, and leadership, reminding us that we are called to be strong in our faith and to lead others to God. The name also underscores the importance of defense and protection, calling us to be warriors of the faith, ready to defend and spread the love of God in the world. Embracing the name Broderick as a Christian can be a powerful reminder of our role as children of God and the responsibilities we have to use our God-given talents and strengths to serve and protect those around us, both spiritually and physically.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Broderick was a common name in medieval Ireland. The name Broderick carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
